outlook.statement: The Company at the same time is in the process of scoping other viable projects and business opportunities.

The Company is well aware of the risks to which it is exposed and has put in place a mechanism to ensure that these are mitigated by timely action. In the opinion of the Board of Directors, none of these risks affect and/or threaten the existence of the Company.

risks: The Company has been on a continuous basis reviewing and streamlining its various operational and business risks involved in its business as part of its risk management policy. The Company also takes all efforts to train its employees from time to time to handle and minimize these risks.
Volatility in gold, silver and base metal prices
Concentration of demand in a small number of markets
Evolving international tariff environment
Credit risk on trade receivables
Risk of obsolescence and valuation loss in inventory
Dependence on imports for ~90% of raw materials (rough diamonds, gold bars)
Elevated and volatile gold prices affecting consumer behaviour and working capital
Cost-of-living pressures weighing on consumer sentiment
Highly fragmented and largely unorganised industry competition
Lab-grown diamond price corrections
Regulatory changes limiting raw material supply
